mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 65 degrees with clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail, but we have a moderate air quality alert with an index of 82. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight's low will reach 51 degrees, and no rain is expected.

City officials are busy with the upcoming November 4th Plan Commission meeting, which will cover several proposals including a final plat for 80 lots at Ardent Glen, certified survey maps for Jenna Drive and Range Trail, and a site plan for 1979 Milky Way.

There is plenty to do in the area, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, you can head downtown for the Dane County Farmer's Market or catch music at Paddy Mac's.

On October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving. No injuries were reported, and the department is currently investigating a possible collision with a traffic sign.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough. Culver's is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10 PM tonight.
